text:
Alex D: Quick gating question — aurora-13b-v1 is provisionally ingested but before we flip the serving flag we need a short checklist: weights path, tokenizer sanity, and license/attribution. Can folks confirm?
Priya K: weights are at s3://redwood-models/aurora-13b/v1/weights/ (sharded, .pt) — CI validated checksum.
Sasha B: tokenizer note: this model uses a custom special token <|persona|> with id 50256, and pad token is 0. It also expects left-side padding (padding_side = "left"). Ran sample tokenization but saw strange BOS behavior on some prompts.
James L: thanks. Can you paste the minimal tokenizer config you used? will add to config validation.
Sasha B: here it is: ```{"eos_token_id":50257,"bos_token_id":50258,"pad_token_id":0,"padding_side":"left","vocab_size":50260}``` — loader accepts it but I want infra to validate runtime embedding offsets.
InfraOps: noted — we'll run a quick sanity job at scale to confirm kv-cache alignment and ensure no off-by-one in generation. ETA ~ later today.
Alex D: license: model-card lists CC-BY-4.0 for weights, and the underlying pretraining corpus says some portions are CC-BY-NC. Legal flagged potential conflict. @LegalBot any guidance on hosted serving constraints?
LegalBot: automated note: CC-BY-4.0 is compatible with commercial use, but mixed-corpus with CC-BY-NC requires redaction or gating. We need the model card to explicitly call out any NC-only portions and we must not enable hosted public inference unless clearance obtained. Please attach full corpus manifest.
Priya K: I uploaded manifest to the ingestion ticket — link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INGEST-452. There are ~3 small NC datasets noted.
Marta R: if NC datasets are small and don’t materially change behavior, can we add a use-restriction flag and restrict to dedicated/private customers until legal OKs?
James L: technically we can set "serve_modes": ["dedicated","private"] in the model registry and block "hosted". Can implement rollout policy to avoid public hosting.
Alex D: good plan. Sasha, can you add a model-registry entry with those serve_modes and attach tokenizer config + weights path?
Sasha B: done — registry entry id MR-2026-aurora13b. Attached tokenizer snippet and s3 path.
InfraOps: I'll schedule the KV/offset test against MR-2026 and include a small regen harness that mimics left-padding contexts.
LegalBot: please also add a minimal attribution clause to the model card: "Contains work derived from [dataset names]. Attribution required as per CC-BY-4.0." Once added, legal will re-review.
Priya K: added attribution blurb to model card and flagged the 3 NC datasets with notes.
Marta R: pinging @James L for the registry toggle + canary: we should canary to internal first, then dedicated customers, then wait for legal sign-off for hosted.
James L: will do. Canary plan: internal -> 5 dedicated customers -> gate for hosted. I’ll open an ops rollout PR and tag infra for the test.
Alex D: who signs off final compliance? Legal + PM?
LegalBot: final sign-off: Legal + Product Security (we'll also verify KMS usage). Add checkboxes in ticket.
Sasha B: one more tokenizer quirk I noticed — during eval some prompts returned an extra leading space token after detokenize when using left padding. dumps: ```input_ids: [50258, 34, 102, 0, ...] -> text: " Hello" not "Hello".``` Might affect metrics.
Priya K: small whitespace issues can skew evals. Add a postprocess strip for now and log to QA. We should fix tokenizer model mapping long term.
Marta R: acceptable as short-term mitigation. Ensure it's documented in model card under "known issues".
Alex D: summary actions: 1) Infra run KV/offset tests (InfraOps) 2) Block hosted serving until legal clears NC corpus (LegalBot) 3) Add serve_modes to MR (James L) 4) Document tokenizer whitespace and temp postprocess (Sasha B) 5) Attach manifest and attribution to model card (Priya K). Anyone object? :thumbsup:
James L: :+1:
Priya K: :+1:
Sasha B: :+1:
InfraOps: :rocket:
LegalBot: awaiting updated card for re-review.
Alex D: thanks all — will check back after infra tests and legal confirmation.
